note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English, with all three castes described; the original states that no specimens were available and that the description follows the original description and figures of Bugnion (1914a), the head measurements of the alate being estimated from the figures. Distribution records, synonymic citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule circular, not constricted behind the antennae, antennae 12-segmented, mandibles vestigial and triangular, without spine-like processes, pronotum about half as wide as the head; worker antennae 13-segmented, postclypeus 2 times as wide as long; alate postclypeus about 2.5 times as wide as long, pronotum 1.66 times as wide as long.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, rostrum brownish red; thorax pale with yellow margins; abdomen transparent. Head almost smooth; abdomen with oblique hairs mixed with a few long, erect hairs. Body length 3.50–3.75 mm. Head circular, not constricted behind the antennae, length with rostrum 1.4 mm, width 0.87 mm; in lateral view straight behind the rostrum. Rostrum narrow and cylindrical, 0.56 mm long; without a rostral process; apex with a few hairs. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segments 4, 5 and 6 scarcely longer than segment 3; segments 7–11 slightly longer. Mandibles vestigial, triangular, without spine-like processes. Pronotum saddle-shaped, small, about half as wide as the head.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head and body white, distinctly pilose, brownish grey intestinal contents visible through the abdomen. Body length about 4.0 mm. Head rounded, Y-shaped coronal suture weak; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2 and slightly smaller than segment 4, the following segments oval, elongate and slightly longer. Postclypeus raised and protruding, 2 times as wide as long. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin raised, about half as wide as the head.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body brownish, head and wing scales darker; antennae and legs pale yellow; abdominal tergites brown and covered with short pale yellow hairs; intersegmental membrane yellow and pilose. Body length without wings 5.5 mm (male) and 11.5 mm (female). Head oval, about 1.0 mm long to the apex of the labrum, maximum width about 1.0 mm. Fontanelle nearly white, oblong, slightly widened anteriorly, its anterior margin with a V-shaped notch at the level of the transverse suture. Compound eyes black and round. Ocelli oblique, close to the compound eye, separated from it by their own width (female). Antennae broken, with at most 13 segments preserved in the female and 15 in the nymph; segment 3 small, shorter than segment 2; segment 4 slightly thicker than segment 3, the following segments slightly thicker, oval and elongate. Postclypeus protruding and raised, about 2.5 times as wide as long. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, 1.66 times as wide as long; anterior margin scarcely raised and with a small notch; posterior margin rounded, emargination rather wide; a white oblique shoulder spot on each side and a faint T-shaped mark on the disc. Hind wing scales slightly smaller than fore wing scales.
